items.name: product-gallery
items.title: Product Gallery
items.description: The product's photos: a main image on your shadcn Carousel with a counter, and thumbnails beside it on a desktop and under it on a phone (scrolling without a scrollbar). Swipe on touch; with a mouse the photo zooms where the pointer is. Pressing the photo opens it full screen on your shadcn Dialog — the screen grows out of the photo and folds back into it (Motion; a fade under reduced motion) — which is also the zoom for touch and the keyboard. The active thumbnail's frame slides to the next; the rest sit at 60%. The first photo loads with priority, the second early, the rest when they are next. Images are data rendered as , or through your renderImage (next/image, say). Compound, through useProductGallery().
